root_cause: The existing commercial cycle invoked fourteen pipeline stages sequentially without per-stage exception isolation, so one noncritical research, growth or provider error prevented subsequent sales, outreach and learning steps from being attempted.
prevention_rule: Invoke each existing authorized stage once under bounded independent SQL exception handlers; return degraded=true with failure_count and per-stage error values without turning any provider output into success. Do not create a second scheduler, bypass consent, revoke authenticators or duplicate external messages.
